title: Tensor square for balanced point scalar data
statement: For a field $k$, commutative ring sheaves $B,B\prime$ on the small pro-etale site of $s=\operatorname{Spec}k$, $a:B\to B\prime$, normalized tensor models $T,T\prime$ [def-sf-point-evaluation-tensor-data], and balanced scalar data $S$ [def-sf-point-evaluation-scalar-data], define scalar coherence by the chain-map square obtained from the canonical sheaf scalar tensor comparison, $T\prime.b$, $S.\kappa$, $T.b$ and $S.\epsilon$. Also require that the canonical sheaf and ordinary scalar extensions preserve the specified flat-term K-flat representatives. No flatness hypothesis is imposed on $a$.
